# graph-manager: runs dashboard (discovery, live view proxy, static graph, start run) ## What to build In `apps/graph-manager`, add the runs dashboard: every graph-execution run and suite in every workspace, in one place. This task adds: - server-side discovery through the engine's library entry `graph-execution/api` - `GET /api/runs` and `GET /api/runs/:ws/:runId` - a reverse proxy that serves a live run's own web page under `/runs///view/` - `POST /api/runs/:ws` to start a run - the **Runs** page (table) and the **RunDetail** page: the live page in an iframe while the run's server is up, or a static graph built from `state.json` otherwise ## Context: files to read before implementing **Engine** (`packages/graph-execution/`, the `graph-execution` workspace): - `src/api.ts`: the library entry, imported as `import { … } from "graph-execution/api"`. It exports: - `stateSchema`, `RunState`, `RunStatus` (`running|applied|done|failed|aborted`) - `scan(repo)`, which returns `{repo, runs: RunEntry[], orphans, checkedOut}`; a `RunEntry` is `{type:"run"|"suite", id, dir, status, kind:"live"|"applied"|"done"|"unfinished", createdAt?, sizeBytes, branches, pid?, features}` - `lockHolder(runDir)`, `isAlive(pid)` - `readWebJson(runDir)`, which returns `{url, pid}` or undefined; written while a `--web` run's page server is up - `suiteStateSchema`, `SUITE_FILE`, `RUN_ID_ENV`, `RUN_ID_PATTERN`, `CLI_PATH` - the `EXIT_*` codes - `src/state/state.ts` (lines 58-79): `state.json` fields: - `runId, provider, model?, startingCommit, integrationBranch, targetBranch?, humanReview, specPath, tasksDir, createdAt, status?` - `tasks: Record` - `tasksDir` is an absolute path. The task files there are `.json` with `{id, content, dependencies: string[]}`; `test-plan.json` is not a task. - `src/web/server.ts` (lines 507-513): the run page server answers 421 unless the `Host` header is `127.0.0.1:` or `localhost:`. For non-GET requests with an `Origin` header, the Origin must match too, or it answers 403. So the proxy must set `Host: 127.0.0.1:` and remove `Origin` (and `Referer`). The page uses only relative URLs (`assets/…`, `state`, `events` (SSE), `retry/`, `abort`, `close`, `merge`, `review/…`), so it works under a sub-path that ends in `/`. - `src/cli.ts` (lines 165-205): `graph-execution --spec --provider --web` hands the run to the OS and exits 0, printing `Started run in the background: ` (or `Run started: `). Exit code 3 means the hand-off was blocked; 2 means a startup error, with the message on stderr. With `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=detached` it uses a plain detached `sh`, and with `SSH_CONNECTION=1` it doesn't open a browser. Check in `src/launch/launch.ts`/`script.ts` whether an env var `GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID` set on the CLI reaches the detached run. If it does, use it to fix the id up front; otherwise parse the id from stdout. - `TESTING.md` (root): the `--provider fake` runs. `GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_SCRIPT` with `{"task:3":{"attempts":[{"hang":true}]}}` keeps a task running. The fixtures `packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__/diamond` and `spec.md` are a 4-task diamond graph. **graph-manager** (`apps/graph-manager/`): - `src/server/app.ts`: - `buildApp`, `AppContext {config, store, …}`, the `// feature routes (one line per feature)` list - the SPA fallback, which must not catch `/runs/*/*/view*` - `src/server/auth.ts`: `needsAuth(method, url)` already protects `/api/*` and `/runs///view*`. - `src/server/workspaces.ts`: `listWorkspaces(root)`, `resolveWorkspace(root, id)`, `insideWorkspaces`. - `src/server/config.ts`: `config.graphExecutionBin` (absolute path to the engine's `dist/cli.js`, or `graph-execution`), `config.workspacesDir`. - `src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` and `src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx`: the placeholders to replace. `src/web/App.tsx` routes `/runs/:ws/:runId` to `RunDetail`. - The auth test helper (in `src/server/auth.test.ts`, or `src/server/test-helpers.ts` if it exists). ## Patterns to follow **Discovery** (`src/server/runs.ts`): ```ts export interface RunSummary { workspaceId: string; type: "run" | "suite"; id: string; status: string; kind: string; live: boolean; viewUrl?: string; createdAt?: string; provider?: string; taskCounts?: Record } export async function listRuns(workspacesDir: string): Promise // all workspaces in parallel; newest first export async function runDetail(ws: Workspace, runId: string): Promise<{ summary: RunSummary; state?: RunState; graph?: { nodes: { id: string; title: string; status: string }[]; edges: [string, string][]; layers: string[][] } } | undefined> ``` - `live` is true when `readWebJson(dir)` returns a pid that `isAlive`. - `viewUrl` is `/runs/${ws.id}/${id}/view/` when live. - The node `title` is the first `# ` heading of the task's `content`, or the id. - Layers come from a topological sort by dependencies. - If the tasks dir is gone, build the nodes from `state.tasks` with no edges. - Run ids must match `RUN_ID_PATTERN`, or the request gets 400. **Proxy** (`src/server/proxy.ts`): - Register it as an `onRequest` hook *after* the auth hook, so it runs before body parsing and can stream request bodies. - For a URL matching `^/runs/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/view(/.*)?$`: - No trailing slash after `view`: redirect 302 to `…/view/`. - Otherwise resolve the workspace and run dir and read `web.json`. Not live: answer 404 `{error:"the run's page is not running"}`. - Then `reply.hijack()` and `http.request({host:"127.0.0.1", port, method, path: rest + search, headers})`. - The headers are the incoming ones minus `host`, `origin`, `referer` and `cookie`, plus `host: 127.0.0.1:`. - Pipe `req.raw` into the upstream request and the upstream response (status + headers) into `reply.raw`. - Don't buffer. SSE (`/events`) must stream; set `X-Accel-Buffering: no`. On an upstream error, answer 502. - The upstream port comes from `new URL(web.url).port`. Only 127.0.0.1 and localhost upstreams are allowed. **Start a run:** - `POST /api/runs/:ws {tasksDir, spec, provider: "claude"|"codex"|"opencode"|"qwen"|"fake", concurrency?: number}`. - `tasksDir` and `spec` are relative to the workspace, must resolve inside it, and must exist; otherwise 400. - Spawn with execa: `node --spec --provider

--web [--concurrency n]`. If `graphExecutionBin` is not a `.js` path, run it directly instead of through `node`. - `cwd` = workspace path - env = `process.env` minus `GM_PASSWORD`, plus `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=detached` and `SSH_CONNECTION=1` - `GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID=gm--<4 hex>` if that works (see above) - `timeout` 120 s - Exit 0: 201 `{runId, viewUrl}`. Otherwise 400 `{error: last 20 lines of stderr+stdout}`. ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `src/server/runs.ts`, `src/server/proxy.ts`, `src/server/routes/runs.ts`, and register them in `app.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `GET /api/runs?workspace=` returns `{runs: RunSummary[]}`, optionally filtered. - `GET /api/runs/:ws/:runId` returns the `runDetail` result; 404 when missing. - `POST /api/runs/:ws` as above. - Register the proxy hook in `app.ts` right after the auth hook. - **GOTCHA**: - `scan()` also lists git branches. That's fine, but run it per workspace with `Promise.all`. - A workspace without `.graph-execution` returns no runs, not an error. ### REPLACE `src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: - A table: workspace, run id, type, status badge (colors: running blue + pulse, applied green, done grey, failed red, aborted orange), live dot, provider, tasks merged/total, created time (relative). Clicking a row opens `/runs//`. - Polls `GET /api/runs` every 2 s. - A workspace filter select, initialised from `?workspace=`. - A **Start run** button opens a form: workspace select, tasks folder (default `.agents/tasks`), spec path, provider select (default `claude`; `fake` is listed as "fake (testing)"). It shows the error text on 400 and navigates to the new run on 201. - `data-testid`s: `runs-table`, `run-row--`, `start-run`, `start-run-submit`. ### REPLACE `src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: - **Header:** run id, workspace, status, provider, created time, and a link back to Runs. - **Live** (`summary.live`): `
